scope: First bounded theory round. Exact local endpoint and fertility-decline checks, plus lead symbolic household checks. Policy at a later inherited state is checked analytically using the existing parameterized sequence theorem, not by a finite paired-policy simulation.

policy_argument.inherited_state: Common cohort masses and actual old financial claims, purchased titles and tenure. Market valuations can jump.
policy_argument.expectation_boundary: Unexpected announcement at policy date. Pre-announcement contracts use baseline expected future price; each post-announcement continuation uses its own future prices.
policy_argument.scope: For sufficiently small initial decline and permanent credit reform near the certified mixed-tenure equilibrium at taste scale 4. Uniformity over intervention dates requires the weighted baseline bound and conditional individual branch margins.
unresolved: Numerical lower bounds on admissible shock and reform sizes
